long_biography.plain_text:
Founding the Metro Dallas Homeless Alliance gave Gary L. Patsley a public use for the financial discipline developed during his banking career. As a donor and finance chairman, he helped shape a public-private response to homelessness. He also led Dallas CASA and held finance and executive-committee roles with the Dallas Arboretum and Visiting Nurse Association of Texas.

In Palm Beach, Patsley and his wife supported the Boys & Girls Clubs of America. He became a trustee of the Society of the Four Arts and the Preservation Foundation of Palm Beach. He has also served on the Palm Beach Island Hospice Foundation board.
